steps.dump: (() => { const plate = document.querySelector('[data-testid=primary-diorama-target-hp]'); const num = document.querySelector('[data-testid=fx-damage-number]') || document.querySelector('[data-testid=fx-damage-number-crit]'); const out = { plate: plate ? plate.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() : null }; if (num) { out.num = num.textContent; out.numTestid = num.getAttribute('data-testid'); out.numFs = getComputedStyle(num).fontSize; out.numOp = getComputedStyle(num).opacity; } return JSON.stringify(out); })()

steps.eval: window.__seedHit && window.__seedHit(42); (() => { window.__hitTrace = []; const t0 = performance.now(); const iv = setInterval(() => { const plate = document.querySelector('[data-testid=primary-diorama-target-hp]'); const num = document.querySelector('[data-testid=fx-damage-number]') || document.querySelector('[data-testid=fx-damage-number-crit]'); const rec = { t: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) }; if (plate) rec.plate = plate.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); if (num) { rec.num = num.textContent; rec.crit = num.getAttribute('data-testid').includes('crit'); rec.fs = getComputedStyle(num).fontSize; } window.__hitTrace.push(rec); if (window.__hitTrace.length >= 30) clearInterval(iv); }, 100); })()
